title: Kim BoA(김보아 by SPICA) & Led Apple(레드애플) Just give me a reason
description:
아티스트 : Kim BoA(김보아 by SPICA) & Led Apple(레드애플)
곡명 : Just give me a reason
"스피카"의 "김보아" 양과 레드애플이 함께한 "뮤직 노트" 프로젝트 입니다!

-----------------------------------------------------------------
By rearranging popular songs, Led apple makes those music with their own colors.
Through 'Music Note', a project that is composed of 50 episodes, they prove that they are a skilled band by showing off their vocals, and live performance skills that could not be easily found on broadcasting.
With the outstanding vocal, Han-byul at the centre of the group, rapper Kyu-min, bassist Gwang-yeon, guitarist Young-Jun, and drummer Hyo-seok form a five-membered band. Along with the unique formation, their music perfectly mixes the sound with guitar, drum and bass, and the Trendy electronic sound to proudly demonstrate Led apple's unique music style.
